$comment: Hand-authored manifest of per-type `details` fields — the machine contract behind cms/baseline/models/card.schema.json's `details` object. `node ui/card/details.build.js` regenerates cms/editors/card/src/details.data.js, the per-type tables in docs/card.model.md and card.schema.json's schemaType options + details digest. `node ui/card/details.lint.js` cross-checks this file against render.js (SCHEMA_TYPES, SUBTYPES, the vocabulary Sets, DETAILS) and every data/*.json instance. Field keys: type (UCM), control (editor widget, defaulted from type), label (defaulted from key), lookup (render.js export, `SUBTYPES.<family>`, ICON_NAMES, or a `vocab` entry below), shape (ref into `shapes`), items (array item spec), fields (inline object sub-fields), display (presentation twin — emits no microdata), noBase (a *Display twin with no machine sibling), requires (sibling key gating visibility), open (free shape — lint skips sub-key checks), also (extra accepted JSON kinds), note (carried into generated docs).

links.note: external-map row: provider ids (google · apple · osm) or {provider, label?, url?}

paywalled.label: Paywalled
paywalled.note: emits isAccessibleForFree: False on CreativeWork / Event / Place itemtypes

brand.note: → Brand.name, rendered in the subheadline slot

brandUrl.note: crawlable <a itemprop="url"> around the brand name

variants.note: ProductGroup — emits only when subtype resolves to ProductGroup

image.note: url, or {src, alt} for the collage tile

reviews.note: detail pages only, never the teaser

industry.note: suppressed when the envelope owns it

status.note: mapped to ActionStatusType URLs; anything else emits no actionStatus

hue.note: ring theme; unknown values drop the attribute

businessType.note: legacy alias — subtype wins; new content should not write it

geo.note: also feeds the map frame and the external-map link row

places.label: Places — a collection on one map (ItemList)

items.note: shape depends on kind — LocalBusiness rows (name, url, branchCode, geo, address, telephone, openingHours[]) or residence rows (type ∈ RESIDENCE_TYPES, name, url, image, imageAlt, datePosted, price{amount,currency}, geo, address, floorSize, numberOfBedrooms, numberOfRooms, yearBuilt)

slides.note: turns the frame into a carousel

download.note: download filename; empty = bare download attribute

description.note: fallback only — the envelope summary owns description when filled

author.note: suppressed when the envelope owns it

systemRequirements.note: one readable line, or {processor, ram, storage}

durationDisplay.note: the machine duration lives on the media item

endDate.note: last film; omit for an open-ended series

movieCount.note: prose only — no count property on the type

datePublished.note: the visible year is derived from it

url.note: renders the row as a crawlable itemprop="url" anchor

movies.note: one hasPart → Movie scope per row

isbn.label: ISBN
isbn.note: shown raw — the page carries the format-detection meta (schema.md § Book)

endDate.note: last volume; omit for an open-ended series

bookCount.note: prose only — no count property on the type

datePublished.note: the visible year is derived from it

url.note: renders the row as a crawlable itemprop="url" anchor

books.note: one hasPart → Book scope per row

geo.note: rides the ROOT — this type IS a Place

calories.note: an Energy — unit-bearing string, e.g. "650 calories"

issn.label: ISSN
issn.note: shown raw — the page carries the format-detection meta
